reason: Chasing supplier exceptions across two ERPs is a real pain and I'd take a free look at it. But I can't put $2,000 a month on a plant budget from a startup on the strength of a pitch; I need to see it catch something real first.
objection: Our data is split across two ERPs and the emails are messy. If this only works on clean exports, it won't survive a Monday with real supplier chaos, and I'd be the one explaining the spend to the CFO.
would_change_my_mind: The free six-week test catches a late supplier date or short ship that would have hit a real work order before we heard about it, and the team says the morning list saved them time. Then a payback number from our own data would get me to a paid pilot.
